title: Dharmendra's Last Wish Revealed Through Hema Malini
summary: Hema Malini has shared Dharmendra's last wish, which was to see the family united. The actress revealed that her father-in-law had expressed his desire for Sunny and Bobby Deol to reconcile before his passing.
summary_points: Dharmendra's last wish was to see the family united.
Hema Malini shared this information through an interview.
The actress also praised Sunny and Bobby Deol, Dharmendra's sons with her sister-in-law.
This revelation comes after Dharmendra's death.
Hema Malini's statement provides insight into Dharmendra's final thoughts.
